about: The schedule's PR 7a (to-dos/gc-mode/mockups/schedule-pr7.md, cut in three; #5017, v2.4966): the chart's two kernels, lifted to src/lib/gc word for word with no caller yet. chartHolds composes what holds a bar (a question, a submittal, a wait, a trade's papers); downloadTextFile saves Export's files. The components are schedule-pr7a-ui.lift.json. No shape moved, so the config has no types and is not in LIFTS. Run: node to-dos/gc-mode/scripts/lift-extract.cjs to-dos/gc-mode/scripts/schedule-pr7a.lift.json <outDir>

pin.about: #5017 merged; the spike before its follow-up (spike/schedule-7a-follow)
